title: BioPhys-Bridge：物理基础生物学跨学科科学推理基准
summary: BioPhys-Bridge 是一个面向生物物理文献的跨学科科学推理基准，包含500个案例和1517个智能体任务，覆盖六个生物学领域和九个物理模型族，要求模型基于证据进行定量物理建模并关联生物机制。初步评测显示 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 证据ID F1 最高（0.360）。
summary_en: BioPhys-Bridge is a benchmark for evidence-grounded interdisciplinary scientific reasoning over biophysical literature, with 500 cases and 1,517 agent-facing tasks spanning six biological domains and nine physical model families. It evaluates attribution, faithfulness, and hallucination reduction; DeepSeek-V4-Flash achieved the highest evidence-ID F1 (0.360).
